title: Cat Ears
wikitext: {{Infobox mousehat |name = Cat Ears |image = Cat Ears.png |achievement = The Beloved Farmer |ad = Reach a 10-heart [[Friendship|friend]] level with 8 people. |price = {{Price|5000}} }} '''Cat Ears''' are a [[Hats|hat]] that can be purchased from the [[Abandoned House]] for {{Price|5000}} after earning the "Beloved Farmer" achievement (reach a 10-heart [[Friendship|friend]] level with 8 people). The hat can also be obtained from [[Desert Festival#Emily's Outfit Services|Emily's outfit services]] at the [[Desert Festival]]. There is a ≈2% chance to receive the gender-neutral outfit with the Cat Ears. ==Notes== * The Cat Ears outfit also includes the [[File:Shirt271b.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Short Jacket]] (with jacket dyed red) and [[File:Genie Pants.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Pants|Genie Pants]] (dyed RGB value 232,216,136). ==References== Male players have 47 possible outfits (1/47 ≈ 2.13%), while female players have 48 possible ones (1/48 ≈ 2.08%). See Content\Data\MakeoverOutfits.xnb. [[wikipedia:RGB color model|RGB]] refers to "Red,Green,Blue". ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.6|Purchase price increased from {{Price|1000}} to {{Price|5000}}.
